name: kelch like family member 6

function.text: KLHL6 encodes kelch-like protein 6. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. It participates in germinal center formation and B cell receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: KLHL6 mutations have been reported in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
